ai_summary: Adani Power Limited has successfully completed the amalgamation of ten wholly-owned subsidiaries, effective September 25, 2026, following required NCLT approvals. This strategic restructuring simplifies the company's corporate structure and consolidates operations, as the merged subsidiaries are now dissolved into Adani Power. The move appears to be a standard corporate action aimed at enhancing efficiency and streamlining governance, with no immediate red flags evident.
